title: Heuristic route safeguard validator and deterministic fallback scorer
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Replace ad-hoc rule checks with a lightweight, runtime-aware validator that evaluates routing DSL configs against heuristics and a deterministic fallback scoring model. Goal: catch unsafe combinations (region+tier+model-variant) early, quantify routing decisions deterministically, and provide actionable fixes and rollout guidance for operators.
acceptance_criteria: Validator produces human-readable diagnostics for every invalid or risky rule in >=95% of random config fuzz tests
Deterministic fallback scorer returns identical ordering across runs given same seed and inputs
CI gate rejects policy commits that increase high-risk routing score by >5% for production bundles
Has offline lint mode (fast) and online evaluation mode (simulates runtime constraints using recent telemetry snapshot)
Can be integrated as a pre-commit hook and a console pre-deploy safety check
technical_notes: Validator will run two phases: static syntax/shape checks (existing schema) and heuristic phase that uses a compact runtime model (weights + deterministic tie-breaker).

Heuristics include: region capacity saturation check, tier mismatch (e.g., routing high-QPS to low-throughput tier), incompatible model variant fallback chains, and cross-region data residency violations.

Fallback scorer computes a numeric safety score (0..100) combining cost delta, estimated P95 latency delta, and compatibility penalty. Use fixed-point arithmetic (integers) to ensure determinism across languages/environments.
Avoid introducing a new full Turing-complete evaluator; rely on declarative rule translation into a constraint graph then apply heuristic passes.
Telemetry snapshot format: last-24h capacity metrics per region/tier, recent cold-start histogram, and KV-cache hit rates. Validator accepts an optional compressed snapshot for online evaluation.
Schema changes: add optional fields on route policies: "route_hint" (string), "expected_qps" (integer), "stateful": "true|false". Backwards compatible with missing keys.
Security: validator reads no secrets. If telemetry is provided, it must be a sanitized snapshot without customer identifiers.
implementation_plan: Week 1: Design heuristic scoring model, determinism rules, and new lint output format. Deliver design doc and example outputs.
Week 2: Implement static validator extension and unit tests for new schema fields; port existing schema checks to shared library.
Week 3: Implement heuristic passes (capacity, tier-fit, variant-compat) and deterministic scorer. Start property-based fuzz tests.
Week 4: Build CI integration, pre-commit hook, and Console pre-deploy API surface. Create lightweight binary artifact for operator use.
Week 5: Run staged migration on internal testorg, iterate on false positives, and add operator-facing remediation suggestions.
Follow-up: Add feature flag for runtime online evaluation using telemetry snapshots and run a 2-week canary before enabling for all policy commits.
rollout_plan: Canary: Enable server-side lint enforcement for two non-critical orgs (testorg-alpha, testorg-beta) for 7 days.
Monitor: Track number of blocked commits, false positives, and operator override rate. Target override <2% after 7 days.
Gradual ramp: 10% of policy commits -> 50% -> 100% over 3 weeks if metrics stable.
Kill switch: console feature-flag to revert to legacy validation in <5 minutes; disable scoring if CI latency regressions observed.
Postmortem and tuning: After full rollout, schedule a 2-week tuning window to adjust heuristic weights based on real telemetry and operator feedback.
testing_plan: Unit tests for all new heuristic passes and deterministic tie-breaker behavior.
Property-based fuzz testing across 50k synthetic routing configs derived from production templates.
Integration test: CI gate that runs validator against a snapshot of the current production routing tree and ensures no new high-risk score increases.
End-to-end: Create a synthetic runtime that replays requests to exercise fallback chains and verify scorer predictions vs observed fallback counts.
Load test: ensure validator online mode (with telemetry) performs within 200ms median on a CI runner for snapshots up to 5000 route entries.
